description: This file defines the 'Entity Bundle' condition plugin class for Drupal, which checks entity bundle types in conditions.

classes.name: EntityBundle
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides a condition based on entity bundle types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity type bundle info service.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for selecting bundles.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the configuration form.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current entity's bundle matches the configured bundles.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Provides a human-readable summary of the condition.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the default configuration for the plugin.
